<template>
  <Menu>hello</Menu>
  <Menu v-if="show" />
  <Menu v-for="item in items" :key="item" />
  <Menu v-once />
  <Menu.Item />
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue'
const show = ref(true)
const items = ref(['a'])
const Menu = computed(() => Object.assign({ render: () => h('div', 'x') }, {
  Item: { render: () => h('span', 'item') },
}))
</script>
